scenes.headline: Turn the real turbofan
scenes.voice: In the 3D Explorer, you turn a real turbofan and tap every part.

scenes.headline: Find the part. Learn why.
scenes.voice: The 3D Detective asks you to find the right part, and tells you why.

scenes.headline: 15 seconds per question
scenes.voice: Then the Arcade: fifteen seconds per question, built from your own notes.

scenes.headline: Perfect round: +2 credits
scenes.voice: A perfect round earns you two credits.

scenes.headline: tred-tutor.de
scenes.voice: Play your way through the exam.
